basic_info.description: Modernized SF Classic with Bay Views in Silver Terrace! Welcome to this beautiful move-in-ready SF classic, nestled in the desirable Silver Terrace neighborhood. Offering Bay views from nearly every window, this home exudes charm and comfort with a bright, and open layout that invites natural light throughout. Inside, you'll find two spacious bedrooms and one full bath, along with a generously sized, newly remodeled kitchen that features granite counters with a waterfall peninsula, and stainless steel appliances. The formal dining room and large living area provide ideal spaces for entertaining or relaxing in style. A separate flex-room offers versatile living options perfect for a home office, in-law suite, second living room, or man cave and includes a wet bar and direct access to a rare, expansive backyard, perfect for outdoor gatherings or quiet retreat. Thoughtful recent updates include refinished hardwood floors, fresh interior and exterior paint that blends seamlessly with the homes original character. Enjoy a vibrant neighborhood with shops and parks just a short walk away. With its central location, this property offers quick and easy access to public transit, major freeways, downtown SF, and SFO delivering both convenience and tranquility in one exceptional home.
